findings.claim: Overlay show and hide are driven exclusively by accessibility events; if Picap closes the detail popup without emitting an event (rare), the overlay could linger until the next Picap event or service destroy. Mitigated by WINDOW_STATE_CHANGED firing on popup transitions and by hide hooks in handlePicapEvent and onDestroy.

findings.claim: findNodeBoundsByContentDescription requires an exact string match against order.ganancia; if Picap ever renders the price with different formatting between the parsed CD and the node CD, the overlay silently hides (safe failure, no crash or misplacement).

showKmOverlay depends on Settings.canDrawOverlays; if the user revokes the overlay permission the feature degrades to a logged warning without user-visible feedback. Same permission contract already required by the WhatsApp popup, so no new permission surface.
